title: Explicit presheaf and category bar terms and maps
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For a small category $\mathcal E$ and a commutative ring $R$, write $\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal E^{op},\operatorname{Mod}_R)$, the module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] for the constant ring on the identity-cover topology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. The explicit presheaf bar terms and maps are the following constructions. For $U,V\in\mathcal E$ and an $R$-module $M$, put $L_U(M)(V)=\bigoplus_{a:V\to U}M$, with its summand inclusions, restriction $(a,x)\mapsto(a\circ b,x)$ along $b:W\to V$, and coefficient map $(a,x)\mapsto(a,f(x))$ for $f:M\to N$. For $F\in\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}$ and $n\ge0$, put $B_n(F)(V)=\bigoplus_{c=(U_n\to\cdots\to U_0),\ a:V\to U_n}F(U_0)$ and $K_n(F)=\bigoplus_{c=(U_n\to\cdots\to U_0)}F(U_0)$, with their summand inclusions $\iota_{a,c}$ and $\iota_c$; include $L_{U_n}(F(U_0))(V)$ in $B_n(F)(V)$ by the same incoming-arrow summands. Restriction of $B_n(F)$ changes $a$ to $a\circ b$, and a natural map $t:F\to G$ acts on both sums by $x\mapsto t_{U_0}(x)$. Use the chain deletion $\partial_jc$ of [def-trf-derived-colimit-bar-system]: on a chain of length $n+1$, delete vertex $j$ from the left and compose adjacent arrows. The initial connecting arrow is $\ell_j:U_{n+1}\to(\partial_jc)_{\mathrm{left}}$, the identity except for $j=0$, and the terminal connecting arrow is $r_j:(\partial_jc)_{\mathrm{right}}\to U_0$, the identity except for $j=n+1$. Define the evaluated face by $(a,c,x)\mapsto(\ell_j\circ a,\partial_jc,F(r_j)x)$ and the category-bar face by $(c,x)\mapsto(\partial_jc,F(r_j)x)$, extending linearly over direct sums. The maps $B_{n+1}(F)(V)\to B_n(F)(V)$ and $K_{n+1}(F)\to K_n(F)$ called differentials are the alternating sums $\sum_{j=0}^{n+1}(-1)^jd_j$. Define the degree-zero augmentation $(a:V\to U_0,x)\mapsto F(a)x$, the evaluated insertion $(V\xrightarrow a U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)\mapsto(V\xrightarrow1 V\xrightarrow a U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)$, and the augmented insertion $x\mapsto(1_V,x)$. The comparison $B_n(F)(V)\to K_n(F)$ forgets $a$ and retains $x$. Write $C=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal E^{op}}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and define $K_0(F)\to CF$ on $(U,x)$ by the colimit cocone inclusion $\iota_Ux$. All these are actual module terms and linear maps, allowing identity arrows and empty categories without finiteness assumptions. This definition records these terms and maps only; it does not assert a cochain realization, a contraction identity, exactness or the existence of a resolution.
